**Is your feature related to a problem?**
A clear and concise description of the problem, e.g. "I can't … when …".

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What should happen, concretely (UI + behavior).

**Which area does it touch?**
- [ ] Customer experience
- [ ] Restaurant dashboard
- [ ] Admin panel
- [ ] Server / protocol (remember to extend `scripts/smoke_test.py` + `docs/PROTOCOL.md`)
- [ ] Database schema
- [ ] Build / CI / docs

**Additional context**
Any alternatives you considered, mockups or links.
